title: 茂凯·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 宽阔树皮面孔表情鲜明，不对称巨型木臂与根须双腿体量清楚。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Maokai is a massive living tree with a broad expressive bark face, an asymmetrical oversized wooden arm, heavy rootlike legs, and green leaf growth. Preserve the twisted trunk anatomy and nonhuman scale without clothing him as a normal man. His face is composed and the bark intact, while any small sapling companion remains a separate rooted wooden form without threatening teeth or explosive motion.
art_direction.scene: A low three-quarter full-figure study, grounded relaxed stance, clear triangular silhouette and one bright diagonal of sunlight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: bark brown, moss, amber light, blue-green shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
